column1: # Harness per row: the row's C analogue `jetstream-files` concatenated, then a driver that
# constructs Benchmark and runs Benchmark#runIteration `iterations` times between two
# performance.now() readings, printed with console.log. Node and Bun run the same file.
# aot_ms is the printed loop time of `quench compile --dynamic-source` output; c_ms is the
# analogue's default run from c-analogues.tsv. Host: Apple M4, macOS, arm64.
